name: Komine Haruna
source:
The protagonist's oldest daughter. After graduating high school she moved out of the house leaving him alone with Chika.

[spoiler]Haruka moved out of the house because her growing feelings for her own father. To avoid committing incest she found a place of her own.[/spoiler]
